title: Page 275
transc:
Ft. Monroe Dec 6 1864 
R OBrien Hd Qrs A. of James
Farmer Rosetta for Knox unity your wreathe is received zodiac
The vassals to Carrie the offal wilby ready sligo morning
Completely filled zebra the ordinance office her at animal is
doing every thing he canto expedite matters pekin most of 
our olive is hear and will comments loading up whelp
tulip I will wick progress Wheaton evening so that you
can make your calculations when to quorum stop I think
I can by wheaten tell you with in an our
when wekin beer eddy open we are ready in every 
other respect Yoke Niagara did you ever see the like
Gen D Sheldon


Ft Monroe Dec 7 1864 
R OBrien HdQrs a of J
Ports mouth libby for polkaer Parker onondaga Dutch sharpes Bergen
zebra send at once plank sharons down to white shoal
stagger house & to crews between there & vernon of
shoals night & day until further orders & keep a
good look out for walnut boots pekin they will not
permit vassals to anchor trance shore & when they are
obliged to do so will tow them off pewter all
boots found sligo windsor by night orday and hold the
persons in them as prisoners Zodiac Keep a good watch
ready furry wag weasel up & chain ready tuslip tulip
give paulding to vassals walrus Niagara how is it now
